name: SteamCodeStatus
description: 将 VS Code 编程状态同步到 Steam Rich Presence / Sync your VS Code activity to Steam Rich Presence.

commands.title: CodeStatus: 打开设置菜单 (Main Menu)
CodeStatus: 切换启用/禁用 (Toggle Enable)
CodeStatus: 切换 ESP-IDF 状态同步 (Toggle ESP-IDF Sync)
CodeStatus: 设置组队 ID (Set Group ID)
CodeStatus: 手动修改状态 (Manual Override)

codeStatus.enabled.description: 是否启用 Steam 状态同步插件 / Enable or disable Steam status sync.

codeStatus.steamAppId.description: 目标游戏的 AppID（例如 480 或 730） / Target game AppID, for example 480 or 730.

codeStatus.displayTemplate.description: Rich Presence 模板 Key（例如 #Status 或 #display_GameKnownMapScore） / Rich Presence template key, for example #Status or #display_GameKnownMapScore.

codeStatus.dynamicKey.description: 用于承载动态状态文本的参数 Key（例如 status 或 game:score） / Parameter key used for dynamic status text, for example status or game:score.

codeStatus.staticArgs.description: 静态参数，格式为 key1=value1 & key2=value2 / Static arguments in the format key1=value1 & key2=value2.

codeStatus.statusTemplate.description: 自定义状态文本模板。支持 {projectName}、{fileName}、{language}、{lineCount}、{filePath}、{folderName}；用 [...] 包裹的内容仅在变量存在时显示 / Custom status text template. Supports {projectName}, {fileName}, {language}, {lineCount}, {filePath}, and {folderName}; content inside [...] is shown only when referenced variables are present.

codeStatus.idleText.description: 没有活动文件时显示的文本 / Text shown when no active file is open.

codeStatus.groupId.description: Steam 组队 ID / Steam party or lobby ID.

codeStatus.groupSize.description: Steam 组队人数 / Steam party size.

codeStatus.showEspIdfActivity.description: 是否同步 ESP-IDF 编译和烧录状态；关闭后继续显示文件编辑状态 / Whether to sync ESP-IDF build and flash activity; when disabled, normal file editing status stays visible.

codeStatus.espIdfBuildTemplate.description: ESP-IDF 编译状态模板。支持 {esp_chip} 和 {projectName}；若读取不到芯片名则回退为 ESP-IDF / ESP-IDF build status template. Supports {esp_chip} and {projectName}; falls back to ESP-IDF when the chip name cannot be detected.

codeStatus.espIdfFlashTemplate.description: ESP-IDF 烧录状态模板。支持 {esp_chip} 和 {projectName}；若读取不到芯片名则回退为 ESP-IDF / ESP-IDF flash status template. Supports {esp_chip} and {projectName}; falls back to ESP-IDF when the chip name cannot be detected.

scripts.build:bridge_x64: dotnet publish bridge/SteamRichPresenceBridge.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o backend/win-x64 && npm run copy:native_win
scripts.build:bridge_linux: dotnet publish bridge/SteamRichPresenceBridge.csproj -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -o backend/linux-x64 && npm run copy:native_linux
scripts.build:all: npm run compile && npm run build:bridge_x64 && npm run build:bridge_linux
